verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is a hosted payments and open-banking API. Whether its source is published under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The pack shows only a public GitHub repo of request-signing helper libraries and mentions SDKs, with no license stated. These are client-side building blocks, not the product's own source, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
